title: Very nice quality
text: Very nice quality. These are very good quality. I've had them hanging across my front porch since July 2nd, 2022. They still look perfect. No fading and the pleats are still there. I hung them using the new tape that is like rubber but sticks and can be reused. They haven't budged so I guess my next review should be for the tape. lol.
